title: Creatine Gummy Lab Test Tracker
subtitle: Every public independent lab test of creatine gummies, 2024-2025
description: Compilation of the three public independent lab rounds on creatine gummies (NOW Foods HPLC 2024, SuppCo ISO 17025 2025, James Smith / Eurofins 2025): label claim, measured creatine, pass/fail, creatinine flags and an NSF Certified for Sport cross-check. Each row links to the lab's own report. Live version and methodology: https://getgummygains.com/creatine-gummies-lab-tested
